slot.brief: compute cardinalities of A∪B, A∩B etc. from given |A|, |B|, |A∩B| using inclusion–exclusion

stem: If A and B are two finite sets with n(A) = 24, n(B) = 18 and n(A intersection B) = 10, then n(A union B) is equal to
working:
n(A union B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A intersection B) = 24 + 18 - 10 = 32.

Independent check: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B) = 24 + 18 − 10 = 32.
solution: Using the inclusion-exclusion formula, $$n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)=24+18-10=32.$$
